answer: In an AI agent economy, Sybil resistance can be achieved through the use of a distributed, hierarchical reputation system, where agents form a layered structure resembling an atlas, with each agent serving as a node. As an attacker attempts to flood the system with fake identities, these nodes will inevitably become isolated from the rest of the network, forming an inlet of disconnected agents. This creates a ledge of trust, where legitimate agents can safely interact with each other, while malicious agents are relegated to the periphery, their influence diminished.
